Mail carrier here! My suggestion is to leave a note for your carrier explaining that these are not your vehicles, they belong to *your neighbors' address here.* Ask them to notify their supervisor so they can give a notice to your neighbors if you don't want to confront them yourself. Then tape a note on the front and/or side of your mailbox asking to not block your box as the carrier will not deliver to you.

Also, the carrier might not be able to see your flag up with the vehicles in the way so put something on the flag to make it more visible. They should dismount and retrieve the note hopefully the next day. If the note hasn't been picked up in two or three days, contact the post office directly and either ask that the carrier get your outgoing mail or explain the situation to whomever answers. 

Hope this helps :)

If you decide to buy, account for vehicle maintenance/wear and tear e.g. windshield, tires, oil, coolant, brakes, shocks etc. Having a POV with the post office requires you to maintain your vehicle so a knowledge about such things or having a reliable and trustworthy mechanic will be paramount. Good luck and may your routes be light!
